description: This file defines an interface for managing the schema of installed entity types and their field storage definitions within Drupal, including methods for retrieving, setting, and deleting these definitions in the application state.

classes.name: EntityLastInstalledSchemaRepositoryInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing the retrieval and storage of the last installed schema definitions for entity types and their field storage in Drupal.

methods.name: getLastInstalledDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the most recently installed definition of a specified entity type.

methods.name: getLastInstalledDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves all entity types' definitions in their most recently installed state.

methods.name: setLastInstalledDefinition
methods.description: Stores an entity type definition in the application state.

methods.name: deleteLastInstalledDefinition
methods.description: Deletes an entity type definition from the application state.

methods.name: getLastInstalledFieldStorageDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent field storage definitions for a specified entity type.

methods.name: setLastInstalledFieldStorageDefinitions
methods.description: Stores multiple field storage definitions for an entity type.

methods.name: setLastInstalledFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Stores a single field storage definition.

methods.name: deleteLastInstalledFieldStorageDefinition
methods.description: Deletes a specific field storage definition.
